onboarding.voiceWelcome: Ojekoo yɛ SafePay. Oyɛ shia mli. Mia Speak Balance enyɔ koni onu o shika, alo kɛ MoMo nitsumɔi lɛ atsu nii.
onboarding.welcomeBody: Ojekoo. SafePay gou wo shika ake, ni wɔ PIN ko jogbaŋ. Shishoo ji jitɛ. Ekomɔ tsɛm alo atsɛm.
onboarding.micBody: SafePay kɛ microphone lɛ ɖe? SafePay shikoo wɔ gbɛji ni ewɔ mli, ekome wɔye aka ahyɛdei.
onboarding.micGranted: Microphone lɛ aye kɛ. SafePay bɛkase wɔ gbɛ.
onboarding.micDenied: Kɛɛ daa. Ekomɔ ejwɛ wɔ Settings mli.
onboarding.micPermanent: Microphone lɛ he jwerɛ SafePay. Kɛphone settings mli ekɛ shi.
onboarding.listeningBody: Ne SafePay ewɔ mli lɛ, microphone lɛ shi. Enyɛ komɛ wɔyɛ bɔtɔn. Ka gyae alo stop, ni SafePay shwɛ.
onboarding.contactsBody: Ekomɔ, ni wɔye din, SafePay bɛtsɔɔ phone nɔma lɛ. Yɛ hewalɛ kome ni wɔyɛɛ lɛ, ebɛbɔ wɔ kɛɔ. Wɔ contacts kɛ ha wɔ phone lɛ nɔ ko.
onboarding.talkbackTitle: Sɛɛ ke wɔye screen lɛ nɔ?
onboarding.talkbackBody: Sɛɛ ke wɔye screen lɛ nɔ?
onboarding.srOff: Wɔ screen reader enyɛ eje. SafePay bɛgbe eha eŋmɔ.
onboarding.micTestRetry: Mikase nibii. Bɔɔ bio, joo komeii.
onboarding.voiceTestNo: Kpɔ gbɛ lɛ joo, ni wɔsɛɛ bio.
onboarding.bioBody: SafePay yaa shika nitsumɔ lɛ he ko kɛ wɔ fingerprint. Wɔ PIN ko jogbaŋ.
onboarding.bioNone: Phone lɛ nɔ fingerprint nyɛ mli. SafePay bɛkɛ wɔ gbɛ lɛ yɛ.
onboarding.bioNotEnrolled: Wɔ fingerprint lɛ nyɛ mli daa. Kɛphone settings, Security mli ekɛ ha. SafePay bɛkɛ wɔ gbɛ lɛ yɛ.
onboarding.bioSuccess: Fingerprint lɛ ye kɛ. Wɔ shika he yɛ ŋaa.
onboarding.bioFailed: Fingerprint lɛ nyɛ ye. Wɔbɛsɔmɔ bio.
onboarding.teachBody: Nitsumɔ etɛ. Bɔɔ: mi shika, ni wɔse wɔ shika. Bɔɔ: kɛ shika aya, ni wɔyaa shika. Bɔɔ: gyae, ni SafePay shwɛ.
onboarding.teachBalance: Yoo! Mi shika ji wɔ shika kase nitsumɔ.
onboarding.teachSend: Yoo! Kɛ shika aya ji shika yayaa nitsumɔ.
onboarding.teachAgain: Sɔmɔ bio. Nitsumɔi ji: mi shika, kɛ shika aya, gyae.
onboarding.doneBody: SafePay eshishi. Wɔbɛse wɔ shika kple shika nitsumɔi, ni wɔ PIN ko jogbaŋ. Bɔɔ mi shika, ni wɔse wɔ shika.
onboarding.exited: Shishoo lɛ gbejee. Wɔbɛkɛshi le Settings mli.
